answer.summary: Deterministic startup failure, not flakiness: the Spring Boot 4.x parent bump in pom.xml left micrometer classes incompatible at runtime. MetricsAutoConfiguration calls DefaultMeterObservationHandler.builder(MeterRegistry), which is missing from the classpath (NoSuchMethodError), so the Spring context fails to load. Every later context load fails from the cached threshold, which accounts for the 672 errors. Retrying will repeat this; fix the micrometer/Boot version alignment.

evidence.quote: Correct the classpath of your application so that it contains compatible versions of the classes org.springframework.boot.micrometer.metrics.autoconfigure.MetricsAutoConfiguration and io.micrometer.core.instrument.observation.DefaultMeterObservationHandler
